title: Concept: Dependency declared with a caret inside a zero major line
description: package.json declares a caret range inside a `0.x` line, where npm only allows patch-level movement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Consumers expecting minor updates never receive them, so fixes that ship in the next minor stay out of the build while the range reads as a normal caret.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Consumers expecting minor updates never receive them, so fixes that ship in the next minor stay out of the build while the range reads as a normal caret.
